title: The Hungry House
author: Ivo Delacroix
blurb: Elodie Lockridge, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
